ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity (dark grey/black) to high-intensity (white) pixels; high macro-level contrast with light pixels primarily concentrated at the lateral margins and fluke tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity central region; extensive white mottling and banding along the outer perimeter of both lobes; fine linear high-intensity striations radiating from the peduncle attachment area toward the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate internal pixel angle of 45 degrees and a bounding-box depth relative to lobe height of approximately 1:6.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with high pixel-amplitude; four distinct major peaks on the left lobe trailing edge and five distinct peaks on the right lobe trailing edge, interspersed with jagged valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal trajectory; initially convex from the median notch, transitioning to a concave mid-section before terminating in convex, upwardly-tilted tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel groupings located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, suggesting significant barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned vertical and diagonal white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the primary dark pigmentation, particularly visible on the lower-right and lower-left quadrants.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue topography at the fluke tips and trailing edges; visible white scarring and parasitic encrustations (barnacles) clustered at the distal lobe extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, 'torn' morphology of the distal tips where pixel clusters extend beyond the primary geometric curve of the fluke lobes.
